اصطخدت (form VIII)
# اِصْطَخَدْتُ (iṣṭaḵadtu) /isˤ.tˤa.xad.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِصْطَخَدَ (iṣṭaḵada)
# اِصْطَخَدْتَ (iṣṭaḵadta) /isˤ.tˤa.xad.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِصْطَخَدَ (iṣṭaḵada)
# اِصْطَخَدْتِ (iṣṭaḵadti) /isˤ.tˤa.xad.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِصْطَخَدَ (iṣṭaḵada)
# اِصْطَخَدَتْ (iṣṭaḵadat) /isˤ.tˤa.xa.dat/: thi
